summary.text: Aiv Puglielli has been a Greens member of the Legislative Council for North-Eastern Metropolitan Region since the 2022 election, at which point no sitting Victorian MP was younger. A musician and theatre maker before entering politics, he is the Greens' whip in the Council and their spokesperson on young people, drug harm reduction and several other areas. He is recontesting North-Eastern Metropolitan in 2026.
